title: course_drafts Status Columns: TEXT draft|published Plus current_layer
description: The agent module shall track a draft's publication state separately from its active generation layer.
rationale: T3 §10.6 identified a latent inconsistency: §5.1.11 implied the draft status field would hold generating/awaiting values, but §4.1 defines only draft|published. Keeping status as draft|published and adding a separate current_layer column mirrors the courses table design (courses.status + courses.current_layer) and makes the G2-S2 migration unambiguous without colliding the lifecycle and generation-progress concerns.
